attack_shape_verbatim: Drop the pot-life mitigation from a copy and attack whether the check fires; hunt for a named risk with no exceeded-parameter or no mitigation.
claim_under_attack: The current CF-RISK deliverable state is complete and accurate for its scope (finding a miss is CLAIM_REFUTED and is progress).
finding: No dedicated 'known failure modes / application limits / mitigations' section exists anywhere in amphora-cro-protocol-packager (checked 8 candidate doc/data files: cro_protocol.md, capture_template.json, falsification_protocol.json, power_analysis.json, mission.md, moonshot.md, capability-profile.json, README.md). The words 'pinhole' and 'pot life' appear only inside the CRO TEST PLAN's own early-kill-gate / acceptance-gate pass/fail rules (e.g. 'no severe pinhole/crater at target WFT', 'pot life below 90 min at 73F'), which are lab-acceptance reject thresholds for the CRO's own screening study, not field application-limit-plus-mitigation guidance for the recipe as applied. Neither 'wetting'/'non-wetting' nor 'film build' appears paired with any application-limit parameter and mitigation anywhere; 'film build' does not appear at all outside this audit's own synthetic control. Zero of the 4 required risks (pinholing, wetting, film_build, pot_life) has a fully-qualifying entry (named risk + application-limit parameter most likely exceeded + mitigation) anywhere in the corpus -- the refutation criterion's first clause ('No failure-mode entry exists for pinholing, wetting, film-build or pot-life') is satisfied literally, not just its weaker second clause. Part 2 confirms the checker used to reach this verdict has real discriminating power: against a synthetic FULLY-COMPLIANT section it built itself, it passes 4/4; the literal attack (delete the pot-life mitigation from a copy) makes it fail on pot_life specifically while leaving the other 3 risks passing, i.e. it can and would catch the attack the directive names if a real section existed.
notes_on_related_but_distinct_material: cro_protocol.md's Early kill gates / Acceptance matrix DO cover pot life and (via 'severe sag, pinhole, solvent pop, cratering, or non-wetting') pinhole/non-wetting as CRO STUDY reject rules with numeric targets and methods. These are real and correctly tagged for their own purpose (deciding whether a screening panel passes/fails), but they answer a different question than CF-RISK: they do not state which application-limit parameter of THIS RECIPE is most likely to be exceeded IN FIELD APPLICATION, nor do they carry a mitigation an applicator would act on. Reusing them as CF-RISK's answer would be exactly the 'confident-looking guess' the done_criterion prohibits.

film_build.mitigation: control WFT-to-DFT via measured volume-solids and spray technique (SSPC-PA 2 style-grid DFT verification each panel); split into multiple passes rather than one heavy pass on vertical/overhead surfaces to stay inside the sag-resistance envelope
film_build.parameter: dry film thickness (DFT) achieved per coat vs the 4.5-6.0 mil target band
film_build.threshold: DFT below ~4.5 mil under-builds barrier protection (accelerated corrosion breakthrough risk); DFT materially above ~6.0 mil in a single pass raises sag/mudcracking risk on vertical surfaces

pinholing.mitigation: hold WFT within the 7-9 mil target band per SSPC-PA 2 wet-film gauge checks every pass; avoid thin trailing edges on vertical drawdown; allow flash-off between heavy coats to let entrained air/solvent escape before recoat
pinholing.parameter: wet film thickness (WFT) at spray application
pinholing.threshold: WFT below ~6 mil (surface-tension/degassing-driven pinholing risk rises sharply under target 7-9 mil band, worst at the low edge combined with high pigment-volume-concentration passes)

pot_life.parameter: mixed-material working time (KU viscosity rise) vs ambient/mix temperature
pot_life.threshold: pot life below 90 min at 73F per the pre-registered early-kill gate; working life shortens further at higher ambient temperature

wetting.mitigation: verify substrate temperature is >=3°C above dew point and soluble-salt test passes before coating; re-blast or re-clean and re-test if either check fails; do not coat marginal substrate on a schedule-driven exception
wetting.parameter: substrate surface profile and contamination state at time of coat (soluble-salt level, blast profile depth, dew point margin)
wetting.threshold: surface temperature within 3°C (5°F) of dew point, or soluble salts above the SSPC-SP10/NACE No.2-cited-adjacent 50 mg/m^2 informal field guidance band, causes non-wetting/dewetting and fisheye defects

pot_life.mitigation: batch-size mixed material to what can be applied within the 90-min window at the field ambient temperature actually measured (not assumed 73F); use smaller kit sizes and stagger mixing in hot conditions; discard material once KU trend crosses the pre-registered stop rule rather than force-applying over-pot material

pot_life.threshold: pot life below 90 min at 73F per the pre-registered early-kill gate; working life shortens further at higher ambient temperature
